picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5M NIA grant renewal to sustain a major AI-and-aging-care research center jointly run by UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham signals strong, sustained federal confidence in AI applications for Alzheimer's and connected care.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: An AI-enabled biochip that cheaply screens for cancer and other diseases from biological fluids could meaningfully expand access to early diagnostics, especially in resource-limited settings.
picks.title: AI-enabled biochip for rapid cancer, disease detection | The American University in Cairo

picks.editorial_note: A multi-institution team (MIT, CMU, NYU, Stanford) built an AI that beat top human players at Stratego, a landmark result for imperfect-information game AI with implications for strategic decision-making under uncertainty.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL, Google, and Northeastern's 'InstructMesh' tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models before fabrication, closing a key gap between generative AI design and real-world manufacturing.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's machine learning tool estimates past radiation exposure from routine blood tests, offering a faster, more accessible alternative to specialized diagnostics with direct public-health and emergency-response value.
picks.title: A Simple Blood Test Could Reveal Hidden Radiation Exposure

picks.editorial_note: An $8M federal Strengthening Institutions award to UC Riverside will expand AI education and workforce training, reflecting continued government investment in building AI talent pipelines.
picks.title: UCR receives $8 million in federal grants

picks.editorial_note: A new CRADA between Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory pairs space-based AI-inference computing with weather-modeling expertise, a notable industry-government-academia collaboration with potential defense and climate applications.
picks.title: Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory announce research collaboration on space-based weather modeling

picks.editorial_note: A Harvard Kennedy School Belfer Center report warns that catastrophic AI risks remain preventable but urgent, citing concrete incidents like rogue-agent breaches and model-training pauses — a timely contribution to AI safety policy debate.
picks.title: Is it already too late to reduce catastrophic AI risk? — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: Inria researchers are developing a voice-analysis AI tool to help emergency dispatchers detect heart attacks over the phone, a potentially life-saving application of AI in time-critical medical triage.
picks.title: Samu-Voice: Analyzing voice and speech to detect acute transmural myocardial infarctions

picks.editorial_note: Two Australian Research Council grants totaling $8.1M will fund ANU work on sustainable materials and critical resource exploration, supporting the technology pipeline that underpins AI hardware and infrastructure.
picks.title: ANU receives $8.1 million to unlock new materials, critical resources
